sloka: ततः तुष्टः महातेजाः श्रोत्राभ्याम् असृउजत् प्रभुः ।तस्मात् जह्नु सुता गंग प्रोच्यते जाह्नवी इति च ॥१-४३-३७॥
transliteration: tataḥ tuṣṭaḥ mahātejāḥ śrotrābhyām asṛujat prabhuḥ ।tasmāt jahnu sutā gaṁga procyate jāhnavī iti ca ॥1-43-37॥

translations.english: Devatas, rishis and gandharvas stood amazed (at this act). They worshipped the magnanimous Jahnu, noblest among men. The devatas entreated the illustrious Jahnu to treat Ganga as his daughter.
